column1: # The evaluation set behind the search-model comparison (docs/build.md): 209 photos from Wikimedia Commons, all
# marked CC0 / public domain, 330 px thumbnails. Fetched by scripts/fetch-eval-set.sh.
# The thumbnail server does not serve byte-identical files twice (metadata differs, pixels do not), so a file is checked by
# its size and mean colour (tests/bakeoff.rs), not by a hash of its bytes.
